Privacy Policy
Privacy Policy
Last updated: March 31, 2023
This Privacy Policy describes Our policies and procedures on the collection, use and disclosure of Your information when You use the Service and tells You about Your privacy rights and how the law protects You.

Cookies are small files that are placed on Your computer, mobile device or any other device by a website, containing the details of Your browsing history on that website among its many uses.
Country refers to: Ontario, Canada
Device means any device that can access the Service such as a computer, a cellphone or a digital tablet.
Personal Data is any information that relates to an identified or identifiable individual.
Service refers to the Website.
Service Provider means any natural or legal person who processes the data on behalf of the Company. It refers to third-party companies or individuals employed by the Company to facilitate the Service, to provide the Service on behalf of the Company, to perform services related to the Service or to assist the Company in analyzing how the Service is used.
Third-party Social Media Service refers to any website or any social network website through which a User can log in or create an account to use the Service.
Usage Data refers to data collected automatically, either generated by the use of the Service or from the Service infrastructure itself (for example, the duration of a page visit).

Collecting and Using Your Personal Data
Types of Data Collected
Personal Data
While using Our Service, We may ask You to provide Us with certain personally identifiable information that can be used to contact or identify You. Personally identifiable information may include, but is not limited to:
Email address
First name and last name
Phone number
Address, State, Province, ZIP/Postal code, City
Usage Data
Usage Data
Usage Data is collected automatically when using the Service.
Usage Data may include information such as Your Device's Internet Protocol address (e.g. IP address), browser type, browser version, the pages of our Service that You visit, the time and date of Your visit, the time spent on those pages, unique device identifiers and other diagnostic data.
When You access the Service by or through a mobile device, We may collect certain information automatically, including, but not limited to, the type of mobile device You use, Your mobile device unique ID, the IP address of Your mobile device, Your mobile operating system, the type of mobile Internet browser You use, unique device identifiers and other diagnostic data.
We may also collect information that Your browser sends whenever You visit our Service or when You access the Service by or through a mobile device.
Information from Third-Party Social Media Services
The Company allows You to create an account and log in to use the Service through the following Third-party Social Media Services:
If You decide to register through or otherwise grant us access to a Third-Party Social Media Service, We may collect Personal data that is already associated with Your Third-Party Social Media Service's account, such as Your name, Your email address, Your activities or Your contact list associated with that account.
You may also have the option of sharing additional information with the Company through Your Third-Party Social Media Service's account. If You choose to provide such information and Personal Data, during registration or otherwise, You are giving the Company permission to use, share, and store it in a manner consistent with this Privacy Policy.
Tracking Technologies and Cookies
We use Cookies and similar tracking technologies to track the activity on Our Service and store certain information. Tracking technologies used are beacons, tags, and scripts to collect and track information and to improve and analyze Our Service. The technologies We use may include:
- Cookies or Browser Cookies. A cookie is a small file placed on Your Device. You can instruct Your browser to refuse all Cookies or to indicate when a Cookie is being sent. However, if You do not accept Cookies, You may not be able to use some parts of our Service. Unless you have adjusted Your browser setting so that it will refuse Cookies, our Service may use Cookies.
- Web Beacons. Certain sections of our Service and our emails may contain small electronic files known as web beacons (also referred to as clear gifs, pixel tags, and single-pixel gifs) that permit the Company, for example, to count users who have visited those pages or opened an email and for other related website statistics (for example, recording the popularity of a certain section and verifying system and server integrity).
Cookies can be "Persistent" or "Session" Cookies. Persistent Cookies remain on Your personal computer or mobile device when You go offline, while Session Cookies are deleted as soon as You close Your web browser. Learn more about cookies on the Free Privacy Policy website article.
We use both Session and Persistent Cookies for the purposes set out below:
Necessary / Essential Cookies
Type: Session Cookies
Administered by: Us
Purpose: These Cookies are essential to provide You with services available through the Website and to enable You to use some of its features. They help to authenticate users and prevent fraudulent use of user accounts. Without these Cookies, the services that You have asked for cannot be provided, and We only use these Cookies to provide You with those services.
Cookies Policy / Notice Acceptance Cookies

Administered by: Us
Purpose: These Cookies identify if users have accepted the use of cookies on the Website.

Type: Persistent Cookies
Administered by: Us
Purpose: These Cookies allow us to remember choices You make when You use the Website, such as remembering your login details or language preference. For more information about the cookies we use and your choices regarding cookies, please visit our Cookies Policy or the Cookies section of our Privacy Policy.

To provide and maintain our Service, including to monitor the usage of our Service.

To provide You with news, special offers and general information about other goods, services and events which we offer that are similar to those that you have already purchased or enquired about unless You have opted not to receive such information.
To manage Your requests: To attend and manage Your requests to Us.
For business transfers: We may use Your information to evaluate or conduct a merger, divestiture, restructuring, reorganization, dissolution, or other sale or transfer of some or all of Our assets, whether as a going concern or as part of bankruptcy, liquidation, or similar proceeding, in which Personal Data held by Us about our Service users is among the assets transferred.
For other purposes: We may use Your information for other purposes, such as data analysis, identifying usage trends, determining the effectiveness of our promotional campaigns and to evaluate and improve our Service, products, services, marketing and your experience.
We may share Your personal information in the following situations:
- With Service Providers: We may share Your personal information with Service Providers to monitor and analyze the use of our Service, to contact You.
- For business transfers: We may share or transfer Your personal information in connection with, or during negotiations of, any merger, sale of Company assets, financing, or acquisition of all or a portion of Our business to another company.
- With Affiliates: We may share Your information with Our affiliates, in which case we will require those affiliates to honor this Privacy Policy. Affiliates include Our parent company and any other subsidiaries, joint venture partners or other companies that We control or that are under common control with Us.
- With business partners: We may share Your information with Our business partners to offer You certain products, services or promotions.
- With other users: when You share personal information or otherwise interact in the public areas with other users, such information may be viewed by all users and may be publicly distributed outside. If You interact with other users or register through a Third-Party Social Media Service, Your contacts on the Third-Party Social Media Service may see Your name, profile, pictures and description of Your activity. Similarly, other users will be able to view descriptions of Your activity, communicate with You and view Your profile.
- With Your consent: We may disclose Your personal information for any other purpose with Your consent.
Retention of Your Personal Data
The Company will retain Your Personal Data only for as long as is necessary for the purposes set out in this Privacy Policy. We will retain and use Your Personal Data to the extent necessary to comply with our legal obligations (for example, if we are required to retain your data to comply with applicable laws), resolve disputes, and enforce our legal agreements and policies.
The Company will also retain Usage Data for internal analysis purposes. Usage Data is generally retained for a shorter period of time, except when this data is used to strengthen the security or to improve the functionality of Our Service, or We are legally obligated to retain this data for longer time periods.
Transfer of Your Personal Data
Your information, including Personal Data, is processed at the Company's operating offices and in any other places where the parties involved in the processing are located. It means that this information may be transferred to — and maintained on — computers located outside of Your state, province, country or other governmental jurisdiction where the data protection laws may differ than those from Your jurisdiction.
Your consent to this Privacy Policy followed by Your submission of such information represents Your agreement to that transfer.
The Company will take all steps reasonably necessary to ensure that Your data is treated securely and in accordance with this Privacy Policy and no transfer of Your Personal Data will take place to an organization or a country unless there are adequate controls in place including the security of Your data and other personal information.
Delete Your Personal Data
You have the right to delete or request that We assist in deleting the Personal Data that We have collected about You.
Our Service may give You the ability to delete certain information about You from within the Service.
You may update, amend, or delete Your information at any time by signing in to Your Account, if you have one, and visiting the account settings section that allows you to manage Your personal information. You may also contact Us to request access to, correct, or delete any personal information that You have provided to Us.
Please note, however, that We may need to retain certain information when we have a legal obligation or lawful basis to do so.
Disclosure of Your Personal Data
Business Transactions
If the Company is involved in a merger, acquisition or asset sale, Your Personal Data may be transferred. We will provide notice before Your Personal Data is transferred and becomes subject to a different Privacy Policy.
Law enforcement
Under certain circumstances, the Company may be required to disclose Your Personal Data if required to do so by law or in response to valid requests by public authorities (e.g. a court or a government agency).

- Prevent or investigate possible wrongdoing in connection with the Service
- Protect the personal safety of Users of the Service or the public

The security of Your Personal Data is important to Us, but remember that no method of transmission over the Internet, or method of electronic storage is 100% secure. While We strive to use commercially acceptable means to protect Your Personal Data, We cannot guarantee its absolute security.

Our Service does not address anyone under the age of 13. We do not knowingly collect personally identifiable information from anyone under the age of 13. pages.text:
Title: 
      Surprise Me! – LUNA LAB
    

URL: https://www.lunalab.ca/products/mystery-design-level-1-4

Surprise Me!
Select your Shape and Design Level. Then leave the rest to us! We’ll create a set for you using our own creative juices.
Hand-painted | Reusable | Long Lasting
Made in Toronto.
No refunds based on sizing, nail sizing is customers responsibility.
LUNA LAB is not responsible for shipping carrier errors.
Options to include liquid nail glue (2+ weeks wear time) and tabs (1-5 day wear time) or a full prep kit.
Prep kits include a mini nail file, buffer, wood cuticle stick, 2 alcohol wipes, and adhesive.
Every nail order comes with detailed prep, application, and removal tips to make sure you get the best looking nails every time.
PRESS ON NAILS
How do I know the size I need?
We offer sizing kits to ensure the perfect fit. Please note that sizes may slightly vary depending on what shape you choose. Please make sure to buy individual sizing kits for each shape that you're interested in.
I know which set(s) I want but I don’t know my size.
No worries! Since you know which set(s) you want you can place an order and add the sizing kit(s). For example, you want to purchase “Picasso” but you want to try the shapes “Medium Ballerina” and “Ballerina” first.
You can place your order and select “Custom VIP” as the size. Then add the sizing kits in “Medium Ballerina” and “Ballerina” to your cart and checkout.
What we’ll do is ship you both sizing kits first. Once you measure your nails, learn your sizing, and send it back to us via DM or email, we’ll get started on your order and send it out to you!
Sizing Kit time frame?
Sizing kits are mailed as soon as possible through standard shipping 2-4 business days. Our processing time starts once you've sent us your sizes NOT when you first place your order.
How many nails come in each set?
All LUNA LAB nails come with at least 10 nails. Full sets come with 20 nails (two of each size).
VIP customers benefit from knowing their sizes with the option to get 10 uniquely sized nails, custom fit to their fingernails.
The "24 Nails" collection features luxe press on nails that come with 24-nails in each set!
What comes with my nails?
All orders come with application and removal instructions. Customers have the option to select their prep and adhesive preference.
1. None
2. Liquid glue and nail tabs
3. Full prep kit. A mini nail file, cuticle pusher, buffer, alcohol prep pads, liquid nail glue
What nail glue do you recommend?
We recommend a professional nail glue such as IBD 5 Second Nail Glue, KDS Nail Glue, or Nailene Super Glue
How long do the nails stay on?
Wear time depends on how well you prep your natural nails before application, how rough you are on your hands and your choice of adhesive. With nails tabs you can wear them for a few days or even a few hours if you're wearing them for a special occasion. With nail glue, for about 1 to 2 weeks.
I'm worried that my nails are going to pop off. Any tips on how I can avoid this?
Make sure to follow our Nail Prep instructions included with your order. This step is key to long wear. In addition, you can apply a Dehydrator and Primer for better adhesion. This is the same product nail techs use before gel or acrylic application so the product can adhere to your nails.
You can also try using both adhesive tabs and nail glue together. Follow nail prep instructions and apply the nail tabs. Then apply nail glue over the tabs or on the back of the nail. Press and hold the nails in place for a few seconds. This dual adhesive combo allows longer wear time.
Are the nails reusable?
Yes. The use of nail tabs will make the nails reusable.
For those that prefer nail glue, we suggest purchasing an inexpensive electric nail file. It'll gently buff away any built up glue on the back of the nails and give you many more wears.
Can you replace a lost nail?
Yes. Email us at info@lunalab.ca
Are the nails strong?
Yes, our nails are made with at least 3 coats of gel polish.
Do you offer custom designs?
We do! If you have a concept in mind or would like us to recreate something you saw on the gram, pinterest... anywhere just fill out our contact form so we can chat ideas.
*We do not recreate work from other press on nail sellers. If you love it, buy it from the original artist.
**Also, please note that not every idea or design fits our design style. So we may decline if its not something we can see doing. For recreations, we may ask if it’s ok to put a twist on the design to make it more our own.
Can I make changes to a design?
Yes, all sets are made to order and may be customized to your liking. If you prefer a different color, matte or glossy finish, shorter length or small design changes simply make a note in the special requests. For bigger changes that include adding on more or changing crystals please contact us first to approve changes.
GENERAL
How long will it take to ship my order?
*Please note that this turnaround is for creation time/ when we ship your order. Not how long it'll take for delivery. How fast you receive your order once we have shipped it out depends on the shipping fee you pay at checkout. Canada-Wide Free Shipping is Standard: 5-9 Business Days. Xpresspost 1-3 Business Days. Priority Express: 1-3 Business Days.
Press On Nails: Our current turn around is about 1-7 days. THIS IS JUST AN ESTIMATE. We do not guarantee that your order will be shipped within this time frame. They may be shipped sooner but can certainly take longer.
All sets are made to order and worked on, in the order they were received.
All of our nails are handcrafted solely by Louna Delicieux.
Sizing Sample Packs: 2-5 Business Days.
We truly appreciate your business and thank you for your patience as we make our way to your order.
Do you ship internationally?
Yes. We ship worldwide.
My package was sent back to you, can you resend it?
Yes of course. Simply contact us to make sure we have received it then pay the Re-Shipping Fee so we can send it back out.
Do you accept cancellations, returns or exchanges?
We gladly accept cancellations within 24 hours of purchase.
But due to the nature of our product; all sales are final (except in the case of products delivered in defective or damaged state. If so, email info@lunalab.ca and include an image of the defective or damaged product).
**Please read all information listed under the item description before ordering.
Also, double check shipping information before checking out. We are not held responsible for packages lost in transit, delivered packages that are missing or with incorrect address.
If there’s an apartment number make sure you enter it to avoid a Return To Sender issue.
If you move during your wait to receive your order, please update us with the new address. We are not held responsible for packages delivered to the wrong address. **

pages.title: The LUNA LAB Nails Story
pages.text:
Title: 
      The LUNA LAB Nails Story
    

URL: https://www.lunalab.ca/pages/about-us

The LUNA LAB Nails Story
Hi, I’m Louna — the founder, designer, and everything-in-between behind LUNA LAB Nails.
Today, LUNA LAB is followed by over 22,000 nail lovers on Instagram, has fulfilled 1,000+ orders, and made its mark at markets, malls, and even a 18-day booth at the CNE (Canadian National Exhibition). But it didn’t start that way — not even close.
How It All Started - The Turning Point
Let me take you back to 2017. I was busy — always moving, always doing — but something felt... hollow. That year, I experienced a blackout from sheer exhaustion, which left me with a concussion and three months of forced bed rest. It was brutal. I had no choice but to lie still and think. And let me tell you, hindsight was a brutal teacher.
But in that stillness, something began to shift.
As I stared at the ceiling for days on end, I realized I wasn’t living life the way I truly wanted to. So I started writing. I wrote about my reality, my fears, and — most importantly — my goals. I wanted a life of freedom, creativity, and authenticity. And right at the top of that list?
“Start a business.”
Not for clout. Not for hype. But because I wanted to finally live.
Why Nails?
People often ask me: "Why nails?" Of all things, why press-ons?
The answer goes way back — all the way to when I was nine years old. I used to love nail art as a kid. I didn’t have fancy tools or a big collection, but I had toothpicks, creativity, and an older sister who believed in me. My sister, Rose (she was just 11 at the time), would use her allowance to buy me nail polish. And I would sit there for hours, using the tiniest tools to create little masterpieces on my nails.
I also grew up playing piano — and every time my nails grew long enough to paint, I’d have to clip them short again for practice. It was a small thing, but to little me, it was heartbreaking. Nail art felt like me, and I hated having to sacrifice that expression.
So when I discovered press-ons, it was like unlocking a whole new world:
💅 I could paint, and design nails — and take them off whenever I needed to.
💅 No damage, no pressure, no compromises.
Just creative freedom.
Fast forward to adulthood, and that passion had kind of faded into the background. But during my concussion recovery, with nothing but time and stillness, I remembered that little girl who found joy in painting tiny canvases. I realized it was one of the few things that brought me happiness just for the sake of it.
And then there were the nail salons. Let’s just say… not my happy place.
I’ve had my fair share of bad experiences — rushed service, painful drills, brittle nails after removal. I wanted something better, something that let me take care of my nails without compromising on style.
Now as a busy working woman with a packed schedule, I don’t have the time (or money) to hit the salon every month. But that doesn’t mean I don’t want to feel like her. You know, that “I’ve got my life together” energy — and sometimes, all it takes is a bomb set of nails to tap into that.
Press-ons gave me back that feeling.
And now, through LUNA LAB, I get to share that same feeling with you.
🛒 Ready to feel like her? Shop here.
Why LUNA LAB Nails Stands Out
At LUNA LAB, every set is handmade with intention. I specialize in short shapes, known for their natural elegance and everyday wearability. Whether you’re drawn to nude neutrals, French tips, or bold customs, every nail is crafted to help you feel more you — on your own terms.
What you’ll get with every set:
💅 Salon-quality finish
🔁 Reusable designs
🧡 Gentle on your natural nails
📦 Packaged with love and care
And no rush jobs here. Every set is made with the same level of detail and care I’d want for myself. Because you deserve that kind of service.
🛍️ Ready for your glow-up?
Shop Previously Loved Sets now
✨ Viral Moments & Global Love
At the top of 2024, one of my Instagram reels went viral, racking up over 4.3 million views. That single reel brought in the exact customers I’d been trying to reach — people who value artistry, care, and intention. That was a turning point for LUNA LAB. I realized it was time to scale. To grow not just in numbers, but in impact — and that meant learning how to build a team so I could focus more on creating and less on everything else.
👀 Follow me on Instagram to see the reel that changed everything.
🏆 Milestones That Still Blow My Mind
This journey has been filled with surreal milestones I never imagined I’d hit:
-
🥇Winner of the 2023 Rise Up Pitch Competition – A moment that validated all the hard work behind the scenes. Watch the process here.
-
🌟Finalist at Elevate Tech Fest 2022 – Standing among creators and innovators and sharing my story was unforgettable. See the highlights.
-
🎪 My first booth at the Canadian National Exhibition (CNE) in 2022 – A 19-day event that pushed my limits and expanded my reach like never before.
-
🎤 Featured guest on The Press On Academy Podcast by ByChloeNails – and the very first guest ever! Such an honour.
-
🛍️ 30+ markets and events around Toronto and the GTA, where I’ve had the chance to connect with so many of you face to face.
💖 More Than Nails: Community, Creativity, & Confidence
The real magic, though, is beyond the numbers. LUNA LAB has introduced me to incredible, like-minded people I never would have met otherwise. I’ve had the honour of mentoring other creatives who want to start their own press-on nail businesses. I’ve also led entrepreneurship and nail art workshops for young girls in community centres — a full-circle moment from that little girl in 2006 painting her nails with toothpicks.
Check out this community workshop I led recently — nothing lights me up more than helping the next generation explore creativity and entrepreneurship.
I’ve also had the opportunity to speak on panels like Toronto’s Very Own at the Ted Rogers School of Management, where I shared what I’ve learned about building a business from the ground up — through wins, failures, and everything in between.
🎯 Still Blooming
The truth is, I’m still learning. I’m still growing. I’m still blooming — just like I dreamed about while lying in bed recovering from a concussion back in 2017. Only now, I get to do it with a brush in one hand, a vision in my heart, and a community of amazing customers like you beside me.
So whether you're here to get your first set of LUNA LAB nails or you're a longtime supporter — thank you. You’re part of this story.
📦 Join the thousands who’ve already discovered LUNA LAB magic. Shop handmade press-ons now.
📲 Don’t forget to follow the journey on Instagram — we’ve only just begun.

pages.title: FAQs – LUNA LAB
pages.text:
Title: 
      FAQs – LUNA LAB
    

URL: https://www.lunalab.ca/pages/faqs

FAQs
PRESS ON NAILS
How do I know the size I need?
We offer sizing kits to ensure the perfect fit. Please note that sizes may slightly vary depending on what shape you choose. Please make sure to buy individual sizing kits for each shape that you're interested in.
I know which set(s) I want but I don’t know my size.
No worries! Since you know which set(s) you want you can place an order and add the sizing kit(s). For example, you want to purchase “Picasso” but you want to try the shapes “Medium Ballerina” and “Ballerina” first.
You can place your order and select “Custom VIP” as the size. Then add the sizing kits in “Medium Ballerina” and “Ballerina” to your cart and checkout.
What we’ll do is ship you both sizing kits first. Once you measure your nails, learn your sizing, and send it back to us via DM or email, we’ll get started on your order and send it out to you!
Sizing Kit time frame?
Sizing kits are mailed as soon as possible through standard shipping 2-4 business days. Our processing time starts once you've sent us your sizes NOT when you first place your order.
How many nails come in each set?
All LUNA LAB nails come with at least 10 nails. Full sets come with 20 nails (two of each size).
VIP customers benefit from knowing their sizes with the option to get 10 uniquely sized nails, custom fit to their fingernails.
The "24 Nails" collection features luxe press on nails that come with 24-nails in each set!
What comes with my nails?
All orders come with application and removal instructions. Customers have the option to select their prep and adhesive preference.
1. None
2. Liquid glue and nail tabs
3. Full prep kit. A mini nail file, cuticle pusher, buffer, alcohol prep pads, liquid nail glue
What nail glue do you recommend?
We recommend a professional nail glue such as IBD 5 Second Nail Glue, KDS Nail Glue, or Nailene Super Glue
How long do the nails stay on?
Wear time depends on how well you prep your natural nails before application, how rough you are on your hands and your choice of adhesive. With nails tabs you can wear them for a few days or even a few hours if you're wearing them for a special occasion. With nail glue, for about 1 to 2 weeks.
I'm worried that my nails are going to pop off. Any tips on how I can avoid this?
Make sure to follow our Nail Prep instructions included with your order. This step is key to long wear. In addition, you can apply a Dehydrator and Primer for better adhesion. This is the same product nail techs use before gel or acrylic application so the product can adhere to your nails.
You can also try using both adhesive tabs and nail glue together. Follow nail prep instructions and apply the nail tabs. Then apply nail glue over the tabs or on the back of the nail. Press and hold the nails in place for a few seconds. This dual adhesive combo allows longer wear time.
Are the nails reusable?
Yes. The use of nail tabs will make the nails reusable.
For those that prefer nail glue, we suggest purchasing an inexpensive electric nail file. It'll gently buff away any built up glue on the back of the nails and give you many more wears.
Can you replace a lost nail?
Yes. Email us at info@lunalab.ca
Are the nails strong?
Yes, our nails are made with at least 3 coats of gel polish.
Do you offer custom designs?
We do! If you have a concept in mind or would like us to recreate something you saw on the gram, pinterest... anywhere just fill out our contact form so we can chat ideas.
*We do not recreate work from other press on nail sellers. If you love it, buy it from the original artist.
**Also, please note that not every idea or design fits our design style. So we may decline if its not something we can see doing. For recreations, we may ask if it’s ok to put a twist on the design to make it more our own.
Can I make changes to a design?
Yes, all sets are made to order and may be customized to your liking. If you prefer a different color, matte or glossy finish, shorter length or small design changes simply make a note in the special requests. For bigger changes that include adding on more or changing crystals please contact us first to approve changes.
GENERAL
How long will it take to ship my order?
*Please note that this turnaround is for creation time/ when we ship your order. Not how long it'll take for delivery. How fast you receive your order once we have shipped it out depends on the shipping fee you pay at checkout. Canada-Wide Free Shipping is Standard: 5-9 Business Days. Xpresspost 1-3 Business Days. Priority Express: 1-3 Business Days.
Press On Nails: Our current turn around is about 1-7 days. THIS IS JUST AN ESTIMATE. We do not guarantee that your order will be shipped within this time frame. They may be shipped sooner but can certainly take longer.
All sets are made to order and worked on, in the order they were received.
All of our nails are handcrafted solely by Louna Delicieux.
Sizing Sample Packs: 2-5 Business Days.
We truly appreciate your business and thank you for your patience as we make our way to your order.
Do you ship internationally?
Yes. We ship worldwide.
My package was sent back to you, can you resend it?
Yes of course. Simply contact us to make sure we have received it then pay the Re-Shipping Fee so we can send it back out.
Do you accept cancellations, returns or exchanges?
We gladly accept cancellations within 24 hours of purchase.
But due to the nature of our product; all sales are final (except in the case of products delivered in defective or damaged state. If so, email info@lunalab.ca and include an image of the defective or damaged product).
**Please read all information listed under the item description before ordering.
Also, double check shipping information before checking out. We are not held responsible for packages lost in transit, delivered packages that are missing or with incorrect address.
If there’s an apartment number make sure you enter it to avoid a Return To Sender issue.
If you move during your wait to receive your order, please update us with the new address. We are not held responsible for packages delivered to the wrong address. **

pages.text:
Title: 
      Your Guide to Press-on Nail Application – LUNA LAB
    

URL: https://www.lunalab.ca/blogs/all-about-press-on-nails/your-guide-to-press-on-nail-application

November 16, 2022
Your Guide to Press-on Nail Application
A regimen you can do right at home. Continue reading to discover how to apply your luxury press on nails. But first, let's start with some Pro Tips:
Prefer to watch a video tutorial?
CLICK HERE
In this YouTube video titled How to Rock Press On Nails Like a PRO! + DIY Nail Care Routine! Jackie Aina shared it ALL!
Email us with any questions about Nail Bonder at info@lunalab.ca or send us a DM on Instagram @lunalabnails.
Get Nail Bonder from our Amazon Storefront!
1. Start With A Clean Base
Shorten and file your nails, push back your cuticles with a manicure stick and buff the shine away from your natural nails with a buffing block. Then clean your nail plates with alcohol wipes and don't touch your nails to keep them clean and oil free.
2. Size Matters
You want to make sure the nails fit before you commit. Find the correct sizes and if you’re between sizes, go smaller so the press ons don’t overlap over your skin. There’s nothing worse than a press on that is wider than your nail bed.
3. Should I Go for the Glue?
For longer wear time (up to 2 weeks), use the nail glue. Apply glue on the false nail first and then directly on your natural nail plate starting from the cuticle area towards the free edge. Be quick. The glue will dry within a few seconds. Make sure to place the nail on straight. Hold and press for 10 seconds. Don't forget to press on the side walls too!

Here’s Why Press On Nails Are The Future
Press-on nails are quickly becoming a game-changer. With changing fashion trends and seasons that call for a different color and design, you don’t want to let your nails’ bright potential to be limited to your monthly salon visits. Not to mention, the cost of each appointment adds up quickly until you start to wonder whether the payoff is even worth it. These problems feel monumental until you realize that there is a simple one-stop solution for them here at LUNA LAB: Press-on nails!
-
Press-on nails are budget-friendly and time-efficient
Press-on nails offer an affordable alternative to expensive salon visits, allowing you to enjoy stylish nails without breaking the bank. Over time, the savings really add up. At LUNA LAB, a single design set costs between $50 and $85. Each nail set is reusable and can last you for days or weeks at a time, depending on your care.
Press-on nails also save you so much time. You are not bound to a salon’s appointment hours and can achieve the look of your dreams sitting at home, in merely minutes. This is a game-changer for students, professionals, and parents who have no time to waste. If you’re trying press-on nails for the first time, we’ve got you! Head over to X to read some pro tips from our founder!
-
Press-on nails give you endless design options
Sometimes, trends can be fleeting and you might want to switch up your nails soon after your salon appointment! From bold patterns to minimalist styles, press-on nails can achieve any look you desire. You can change them as often or as less as you like, without the limitations of salon offerings. At LUNA LAB, we offer several design bundles for you to choose from. Each style will be carefully hand-painted so it can look exactly like you pictured it!
-
Press-on nails are healthier for your nails
Press-on nails are less harsh on your nails and can keep your nail health intact in the long run. With control in the process, you can choose less harmful chemicals and tools to ensure that your nails get the treatment they deserve and still look on point. They also require minimal maintenance and are easy to replace when needed. Less upkeep means more time to enjoy your flawless nails.
-
Press-on nails let you achieve a salon look at home
Salon appointments can be hard to maintain when you have a busy schedule. That is why LUNA LAB press-on nails are made with perfect precision and detail, helping you achieve that salon look right at home. Our luxury press-on nails are designed to mimic the look of salon manicures. You can choose between customised designs or your signature looks, and what was earlier only possible in the salon, can now be achieved sitting in the comfort of your home!

pages.title: How to Apply Press On Nails Like a Pro – LUNA LAB
pages.text:
Title: 
      How to Apply Press On Nails Like a Pro – LUNA LAB
    

URL: https://www.lunalab.ca/blogs/all-about-press-on-nails/how-to-apply-press-on-nails-like-a-pro

How to Apply Press On Nails Like a Pro
When it comes to manicures, press ons are taking over the conversation! We don’t have to tell you that a polished, chip-free set of nails can instantly lift your whole mood. And when you can get that boost for a fraction of the salon cost, in just a few minutes, and without the damage or commitment --- who could say no?
Depending on the way they’re applied, press ons can last anywhere between a few short hours and two whole weeks. But whether you’re going for a look that lasts one night or for the long haul, there are a few important rules you should follow.
SIZE MATTERS
You want to make sure the nails fit before you commit. So do a little size check and if you’re between sizes, go smaller so the press ons don’t overlap over your skin. There’s nothing worse than a press on that is wider than your nail bed. That’s a dead giveaway.
PREP
Just like a classic manicure, prep is key! And when you buy a set from LUNA LAB, you can also get a full prep kit that comes with the tools you need to apply your nails flawlessly. Use the nail file to file around your nails and use the buffer to lightly buff the surface of your nails. You want to ensure that the press ons have a smooth base to stick onto. Next use the orange wood stick to push your cuticles back, but only if it’s necessary for you. Finally, use the alcohol wipe to cleanse your nail bed of any dust and bacteria.
SHOULD I GO FOR THE GLUE? OR THE TABS?
If you want something temporary, use the adhesive nail tabs that come with your package.
For longer wear time, use the nail glue. Put a drop of glue on your natural nail and spread it all over your nail bed from cuticle to tip. Please don’t put so much nail glue that it’s dripping off your nails. Then, you want to do the exact same thing on the bottom of the press on. Saturate the press on, slide it under your cuticle, and then press down for about 10-15 seconds. Always do your pinky’s first. Or to put it in reverse, do your thumbs last! You want to keep your thumbs free because you’ll be doing most of the pressing with your thumbs.
Now that we’ve covered the basics, it’s time for you to try our press on nail alternatives to better protect your nails from damage!

Transparent Strong Adhesive Nail Glue Stickers
Our nail tabs are made of high quality material with high viscosity and are long lasting making your press on nails sturdy and durable.
Nail tabs are non-damaging and protect your nails from traditional glue, making press on nails reusable and easy to remove.
The transparent material leaves your manicure looking more realistic and natural.
Application Tips
1. Choose a sticker that fits the tip of the false nail.
2. Take out the sticker and place it on the false nail.
3. Gently press the sticker to make sure there are no air bubbles or gaps between the sticker and the tip of the fake nail.
4. Remove the protective film from the sticker.
5. Place the tip of the press on nail on your finger and hold it down for about 15 seconds.
Removal Tips
Simply soak your hands in warm water for 2 minutes, then use a cuticle pusher/orange wood stick to remove the press on nails by pushing them from the side of the nail.
Warm Tips
Please keep away from water for one hour after application and avoid leaving your hands in water for too long.

Wear time depends on how well you prep your natural nails before application, how rough you are on your hands and your choice of adhesive. With nails tabs you can wear them for a few days or even a few hours if you're wearing them for a special occasion. With nail glue, for about 1 to 2 weeks.

pages.title: The LUNA LAB Nails Story
pages.text:
Title: 
      The LUNA LAB Nails Story
    

URL: https://www.lunalab.ca/blogs/all-about-press-on-nails/the-luna-lab-nails-story

The LUNA LAB Nails Story
Hi, I’m Louna — the founder, designer, and everything-in-between behind LUNA LAB Nails.
Today, LUNA LAB is followed by over 22,000 nail lovers on Instagram, has fulfilled 1,000+ orders, and made its mark at markets, malls, and even a 18-day booth at the CNE (Canadian National Exhibition). But it didn’t start that way — not even close.
How It All Started - The Turning Point
Let me take you back to 2017. I was busy — always moving, always doing — but something felt... hollow. That year, I experienced a blackout from sheer exhaustion, which left me with a concussion and three months of forced bed rest. It was brutal. I had no choice but to lie still and think. And let me tell you, hindsight was a brutal teacher.
But in that stillness, something began to shift.
As I stared at the ceiling for days on end, I realized I wasn’t living life the way I truly wanted to. So I started writing. I wrote about my reality, my fears, and — most importantly — my goals. I wanted a life of freedom, creativity, and authenticity. And right at the top of that list?
“Start a business.”
Not for clout. Not for hype. But because I wanted to finally live.
Why Nails?
People often ask me: "Why nails?" Of all things, why press-ons?
The answer goes way back — all the way to when I was nine years old. I used to love nail art as a kid. I didn’t have fancy tools or a big collection, but I had toothpicks, creativity, and an older sister who believed in me. My sister, Rose (she was just 11 at the time), would use her allowance to buy me nail polish. And I would sit there for hours, using the tiniest tools to create little masterpieces on my nails.
I also grew up playing piano — and every time my nails grew long enough to paint, I’d have to clip them short again for practice. It was a small thing, but to little me, it was heartbreaking. Nail art felt like me, and I hated having to sacrifice that expression.
So when I discovered press-ons, it was like unlocking a whole new world:
💅 I could paint, and design nails — and take them off whenever I needed to.
💅 No damage, no pressure, no compromises.
Just creative freedom.
Fast forward to adulthood, and that passion had kind of faded into the background. But during my concussion recovery, with nothing but time and stillness, I remembered that little girl who found joy in painting tiny canvases. I realized it was one of the few things that brought me happiness just for the sake of it.
And then there were the nail salons. Let’s just say… not my happy place.
I’ve had my fair share of bad experiences — rushed service, painful drills, brittle nails after removal. I wanted something better, something that let me take care of my nails without compromising on style.
Now as a busy working woman with a packed schedule, I don’t have the time (or money) to hit the salon every month. But that doesn’t mean I don’t want to feel like her. You know, that “I’ve got my life together” energy — and sometimes, all it takes is a bomb set of nails to tap into that.
Press-ons gave me back that feeling.
And now, through LUNA LAB, I get to share that same feeling with you.
🛒 Ready to feel like her? Shop here.
Why LUNA LAB Nails Stands Out
At LUNA LAB, every set is handmade with intention. I specialize in short shapes, known for their natural elegance and everyday wearability. Whether you’re drawn to nude neutrals, French tips, or bold customs, every nail is crafted to help you feel more you — on your own terms.
What you’ll get with every set:
💅 Salon-quality finish
🔁 Reusable designs
🧡 Gentle on your natural nails
📦 Packaged with love and care
And no rush jobs here. Every set is made with the same level of detail and care I’d want for myself. Because you deserve that kind of service.
🛍️ Ready for your glow-up?
Shop Previously Loved Sets now
✨ Viral Moments & Global Love
At the top of 2024, one of my Instagram reels went viral, racking up over 4.3 million views. That single reel brought in the exact customers I’d been trying to reach — people who value artistry, care, and intention. That was a turning point for LUNA LAB. I realized it was time to scale. To grow not just in numbers, but in impact — and that meant learning how to build a team so I could focus more on creating and less on everything else.
👀 Follow me on Instagram to see the reel that changed everything.
🏆 Milestones That Still Blow My Mind
This journey has been filled with surreal milestones I never imagined I’d hit:
-
🥇Winner of the 2023 Rise Up Pitch Competition – A moment that validated all the hard work behind the scenes. Watch the process here.
-
🌟Finalist at Elevate Tech Fest 2022 – Standing among creators and innovators and sharing my story was unforgettable. See the highlights.
-
🎪 My first booth at the Canadian National Exhibition (CNE) in 2022 – A 19-day event that pushed my limits and expanded my reach like never before.
-
🎤 Featured guest on The Press On Academy Podcast by ByChloeNails – and the very first guest ever! Such an honour.
-
🛍️ 30+ markets and events around Toronto and the GTA, where I’ve had the chance to connect with so many of you face to face.
💖 More Than Nails: Community, Creativity, & Confidence
The real magic, though, is beyond the numbers. LUNA LAB has introduced me to incredible, like-minded people I never would have met otherwise.
I’ve also led entrepreneurship and nail art workshops for young girls in community centres — a full-circle moment from that little girl in 2006 painting her nails with toothpicks.
Check out this community workshop I led in collaboration with NCP Youth Community Connections! Nothing lights me up more than helping the next generation explore creativity and entrepreneurship.
I’ve also had the opportunity to speak on panels like Toronto’s Very Own at the Ted Rogers School of Management, where I shared what I’ve learned about building a business from the ground up — through wins, failures, and everything in between.
Still Blooming
The truth is, I’m still learning. I’m still growing. I’m still blooming — just like I dreamed about while lying in bed recovering from a concussion back in 2017. Only now, I get to do it with a brush in one hand, a vision in my heart, and a community of amazing customers like you beside me.
So whether you're here to get your first set of LUNA LAB nails or you're a longtime supporter — thank you. You’re part of this story.
📦 Join the thousands who’ve already discovered LUNA LAB magic. Shop handmade press-ons now.
📲 Don’t forget to follow the journey on Instagram — we’ve only just begun.

pages.title: Why choose LUNA LAB’s luxury press-on nails
pages.text:
Title: 
      Why choose LUNA LAB’s luxury press-on nails
    

URL: https://www.lunalab.ca/blogs/all-about-press-on-nails/why-choose-luna-lab-s-luxury-press-on-nails-4

Why choose LUNA LAB’s luxury press-on nails
I always meet people who tell me that press-on nails changed the game for them.
While they already knew about the convenience and cost benefits, what took them by surprise was how they could achieve a salon manicure at home and completely on their own. From glossy and ombre press-on nails to almond and stiletto shapes, any nail look is possible with the right LUNA LAB set!
As much as I think the logistical benefits (outlined in another blog) of press-on nails are significant, I want to list out the stylistic benefits of trying a custom or pre-designed nail set at home. Here are my top 3 reasons why a LUNA LAB press-on nail set can give your nails the luxury look and feel you deserve:
-
Handcrafted with precision
Each nail set you order from LUNA LAB is handcrafted by a nail artist (me!). I paint each stroke carefully and to closely match my customers’ vision. That means that each nail set made by LUNA LAB has been made intentionally and with precision.
If you order a custom design, the nails you put on will be exactly what you had in mind, being applied by you. LUNA LAB makes the process easier of course, so that application and removal are both safe and quick. You can now flaunt the nails that you designed as completely and authentically your own!
-
High quality and durability
It’s just as important for your press-on nails to feel right as if for them to look good. We use handmade gel sets, the same material used by most quality salons. Under press-on nails, your nail health can remain preserved. This is beneficial in the long run, making sure your nails don’t become too brittle and helps avoid nail damage.
At LUNA LAB, the size of your press-on nail set is fully in your control. If you are unsure of which size fits your nail bed, order our sizing kit and choose from 11 different nail shapes. A trial will help you ensure your nails look exactly how you want them!
-
Customised for your style
You can order three types of press-on nail sets here at LUNA LAB: custom, pre-designed or artist’s choice!
Custom nail sets are a customer favorite. You get to choose nails based on the styles you like, whether that is bold and colorful or minimalist and trendy! Each season can be its own color and design, making this choice one of the most luxurious aspects of ordering handmade press-on nails! You can also be completely unique and share your ideas which we would love to help you realise. There is nothing like the luxury of wearing something picked out by you.
Have a look at previously loved sets we made for custom orders to find inspiration for your own set!
Or maybe you already love some of the designs we offer and which have been loved by many before you. Another customer favorite is selecting the artist’s choice nails - experiment with your style and let us surprise you with a set!
For events such as weddings, parties, or a vacation, reusable press-on nails can help you achieve a luxurious look without breaking the bank. It is not just a convenient and affordable option, it also makes you feel accomplished and happy with the way your nails look, all thanks to you!

Title: 
      Why nail health matters: How to make them look good without compromisi – LUNA LAB
    

URL: https://www.lunalab.ca/blogs/all-about-press-on-nails/why-nail-health-matters-how-to-make-them-look-good-without-compromising-1

Why nail health matters: How to make them look good without compromising
In a previous blog, I talked about the luxury that your press-on nails can exude despite costing less and letting you gain more control over your nail health. As much as it is important for your press-on nails to look good and feel right, it is also important for them to be used safely to ensure your nail health remains intact.
It’s easy to disregard nail health because short-term effects are often not as drastic. The changes that happen over time are more important to prevent. Not only can real nails become brittle if press-ons aren’t applied and removed carefully, bacteria can get trapped inside nail beds leading to risks of infections. This is avoidable by practicing regular TLC )tender loving care) with your nails and hands, and using the right materials when putting on false nails.
There are many signs to tell whether your nails are healthy. What I like about press-on nail sets is that I can remove them when I feel like they are hampering my life or I don’t need them. For example, I remove my press-ons when putting on my eye lenses. Later, I can choose to put the same ones back on or change it up if I want. Sometimes, the temporary removal is also necessary to give my nails the break they need.
Here’s why press-on nails are better for your nail health in the long run:
No unfamiliar harsh chemicals that salons may use
The biggest problem with trusting a new salon with your nails is that you cannot be sure about the products they are using. Repeated exposure to strong acrylic liquids and gels can dry out nails and irritate your cuticles, leading to damage that can be hard to reverse. At LUNA LAB, we use hypoallergenic nail adhesives to reduce the risk of an allergic reaction. We also offer vegan and cruelty-free nails to make sure your gel press-on nails are as comfortable as possible.
Breathable breaks for your nails
Press-on nails are easy to take off between uses, allowing nails and cuticles time to recover. While the idea that “nails need to breathe” has been proven a misconception, it is still important to allow them to be their natural selves. This isn’t as easy to achieve with salon nails because you are much more removed from the application and removal process. With control in the situation, you can learn to understand what your nails need and how to best take care of them. They may not need to breathe, but it is healthy to just let them (and you) relax in between applications!
Gentle on your cuticles
Press-on nails are cute and cuticle-friendly! While these tiny pieces of skin are easy to ignore, they are actually crucial to your nail health. And when nails are not treated with care, cuticles are usually the first ones to suffer. Some salons can also be a bit rough with your cuticles, especially with vigorous scraping or excessive buffing. Press-on nails do not involve any harsh filing (if you’re careful), making sure your cuticles are safer. We recommend cuticle oil to keep them hydrated.
You can buy a cuticle oil pen along with your press-on nail set. It is designed to encourage nail growth and penetrate deeply to heal and protect worn-down cuticles and damaged nails.
Much safer and relaxed removal
Removing press-on nails safely is key to taking care of your nails. At LUNA LAB, you will find not just non-damaging nail extensions but also extensive guides on how to best apply and remove your nails. Every nail order comes with detailed prep, application, and removal tips to make sure you get the best looking nails every time.
Removal can be a daunting task, especially because you might feel a bit scared of hurting yourself or causing damage to your nails in the process. But I am here to help; removal is supposed to be quick, painless, and even therapeutic. Here is how I do it:
-
Fill up a bowl with warm to hot water.
-
Add any dish soap or oil - they help loosen the glue. Any oil or dish soap does the trick! Give it a good mix.
-
Have a seat and get ready to…relax. That’s right, this is the perfect time to unwind!
-
Soak your nails in the water for 5-10 minutes.
-
Use a cuticle pusher (included in the LUNA LAB prep kit) to gently lift the press-on nail from your natural nail. If it isn’t budging, soak your nails for a few minutes more.
-
Repeat for each nail.
-
Buff your nails (buffer included in the LUNA LAB prep kit) to remove the glue residue from your natural nails, smoothening them out again. Go slow and make sure you are gentle with your cuticles!
-
File your nails (mini nail file included in the LUNA LAB prep kit). Your natural nail has definitely grown out under your press ons so bring them back to the shape you’d like!
-
Nip your cuticles (wood cuticle stick included in the LUNA LAB prep kit). You could also just choose to push them back instead!
Find detailed tutorials and instructions for nail removal on my instagram!
I use much less force, allow my nails the time they need, and make the removal process a relaxing one I enjoy! This is super simple to do on your own; all tools you need are already available in your LUNA LAB nail prep kit.
Press-on nails ensure significantly less damage than salons, and give you FULL control in the process with a margin of the cost. Start looking for the nail size and style that fits YOUR lifestyle!

pages.text:
Title: 
      What’s in your LUNA LAB nail prep kit?
    

URL: https://www.lunalab.ca/blogs/all-about-press-on-nails/what-s-in-your-luna-lab-nail-prep-kit

What’s in your LUNA LAB nail prep kit?
When starting with press-on nails for the first time, you might feel concerned about whether you have the right materials to get started. Naturally, you do not have a salon set up at home so how could you possibly achieve the same precision when doing it yourself?
I always tell my clients that anyone can learn how to do their own nails. All you need is the right tools and then the right instructions to learn how to use them. The process is simple and I am here to help you every step of the way!
Once you have figured out your nail size and shape with the LUNA LAB Sizing Kit, all you have to do is place your order. You can choose between three tool options free of cost:
-
None
-
Adhesive only: This includes liquid glue and nail tabs
-
Full prep kit
Let’s say you choose the full prep kit. Here’s what you will find in your LUNA LAB once it arrives on your doorstep:
-
Nail Set
The first and most important thing I add to your order is your nail set! Each order comes with 10 nails made to fit your unique nail sizes.
-
Liquid nail glue
We send a strong nail glue that is gentle on your nails when you apply and remove. The glue dries in 30 seconds, so putting your nails on won’t take too long. Nails applied using glue have a 2+ weeks wear time.
-
Adhesive nail tabs
Adhesive nail tabs are used as an alternative to nail glue, and have a shorter wear time of 1-10 days. Mostly used for occasions, they are much easier to remove and do not risk any damage to your natural nails.
-
Mini nail file
The nail file is helpful to shape your natural nails as a part of the prep process. This ensures that the press-on nails can stay perfectly in place.
-
Mini buffer
The mini buffer helps remove any glue residue from your nails, making them sleek and smooth for when you want to leave them bare. It also helps ensure a smooth surface under your press-on nails.
-
Cuticle pusher
The cuticle pusher is a wooden stick which, as you can guess, pushes back your cuticle so your nail bed can take its right shape and look more elongated. This is usually done after your press-on nails have been removed and your hands have soaked in warm soapy water for a few minutes, to ensure your cuticles go into their edges easily and painlessly.
-
Alcohol prep pads
Alcohol prep pads are the safest way to clean your nail bed, removing any glue, paint, oil or dust on the surface or edges. It also helps to dehydrate your natural nails making the glue or tabs stick better.
-
Detailed instructions
Each nail set comes with detailed instructions that outline every step of the nail application process. If you have any questions, you can also reach out to LUNA LAB on instagram, read our FAQs, or reach out to us at info@lunalab.ca.
And that’s it! These 8 simple tools are all you need to get started on your press-on nail journey. Happy application and good luck!

Title:

URL: https://www.lunalab.ca/blogs/all-about-press-on-nails/my-2025-small-business-vision-board-that-inspires-me-every-day

My 2025 Small Business Vision Board that inspires me every day
I first heard the idea of a vision board on social media and instantly fell in love with the idea! There is some magic to materializing your dreams and goals that makes them feel more attainable. I always like to create reminders for myself of what I had set out to achieve. When life gets super busy and overwhelming, I like to look at it to center myself.
My vision board for LUNA LAB combines how I want to grow my business and myself as a business owner.
Grow my YouTube channel
One of my biggest goals this year is to grow a community on YouTube. I want my content to be reflective of my unique journey as a businesswoman who has learned and grown with time. This channel is where I will speak about ways I set up my business, the mistakes I made, the lessons I learned, and what you never hear business owners speak about—the harsh realities and the sweet rewards. Having a business is a very personal journey. I have found that there are ebbs and flows in my work. Sometimes I have to let things happen and sometimes I have to let them go!
Create content that adds value
There is a whole world of content out there and businesses have to work hard to make sure that they create something that stands out. While I want to attract a big audience, I also want to maintain my authentic touch with my art and work. I want to create content that is engaging, informative, and helps whoever it reaches. Continue to offer high-quality nails that solve your nail pains

Our goal is to elevate our products every day and keep clients happy. Luxury press-on nails are our forte, and we will work hard to ensure they reach all the people who are looking for a quick stylish fix to their nail woes!
Find balance so I can show up as my best possible self
It’s easy to get so wholeheartedly involved with your passion project that health and wellness become the last item on your priority list. This happened to me years ago, when I burnt myself out during university, and that is when I found LUNA LAB. It helped me get back to my inner artist, my younger version who loved creating intricate nail designs and painting tiny canvases.
A mistake I made in 2017 of trying to do it all without taking the right care of myself, led me to the creativity sanctuary that is now LUNA LAB. This year, I want to restore balance in all aspects of my life so I can continue doing what I love the most and do it well—painting nail sets that help my customers feel like the best version of themselves. Just like how I feel when I am painting them!
Believe in my power
This brand is a direct result of my passion and drive. I have come far with it and the path I paved on this journey reflects all the work I put in. The long hours, the sleepless nights, the hustle and grind that teaches me new lessons every day, LUNA LAB continues to grow every day and with it, so do I. This year, I want us to travel even further and reach new heights.
Success has many definitions but to me, it takes the shape of personal growth. If I prosper, only then my business can. Every time I feel defeated, I look back on this vision board and it reminds me of all the reasons why I embarked on this journey. It is tough, challenging, even painful at times but it is everything I wanted! This is your sign to make a vision board for yourself so you can come one step closer to making your dreams come true!

pages.title: The Mother’s Day Market Story: How I set up shop as a small online-bus – LUNA LAB
pages.text:
Title: 
      The Mother’s Day Market Story: How I set up shop as a small online-bus – LUNA LAB
    

URL: https://www.lunalab.ca/blogs/all-about-press-on-nails/the-mother-s-day-market-story-how-i-set-up-shop-as-a-small-online-business-owner

The Mother’s Day Market Story: How I set up shop as a small online-business owner
One of my favorite things to do as a small-business owner is take my business on the road. I love setting up shop in markets and bringing visibility to LUNA LAB, showing off my beautiful press-on nail sets in the process. Today, I want to walk you through my tried and tested method of setting up shop at a vendor market as a small-business owner.
9 AM: Gather my supplies and load them in my car
After doing several markets where I would either forget something or drag way more stuff than I need, I now employ an efficient way of carrying the right supplies and equipment to a market. Here is what helped me:
-
Bins for the win: I have 3 big bins - each labelled and serving a different purpose. My product is usually in these bins well covered under another layer for protection.
-
A sturdy wagon: I do markets on my own often which is why I do all my prep keeping in mind that I might not have help! A wagon helps me carry my bins and any extra equipment I need to bring. The good news is that wagons are super cheap on Canadian Tire or Amazon, making them a quick fix for my small-business owner woes.
9:30 AM: Reach the venue and unload my supplies
Once I reach the venue, I immediately get to work. The first thing I do is get my table or booth ready. Then I get my signage out, like a banner or a poster. Next come my supplies such as a tablecloth, stands for my flyers, and any marketing material I want to lay out. For this market, I also carried a bouquet of roses to give out to moms for their special day.
When setting up, I maintain room for my product i.e. the LUNA LAB press-on nails. These take center stage at the end, so I can make sure they remain in their pristine condition.
9:45 AM: Bring out the stars of the show
The final step in getting ready to start selling is to lay out the product. I usually carry 40-50 sets so I have a variety of designs to lay out. Usually I will have 2-3 sets of each shape and size. I pick the sets based on the type of market. In this case, I decided to pick colors and patterns that were a mix of sophistication and comfort. I tried to make sure that I had something for each kind of mom.
Here are some tips that have helped me plan the way I set up shop in booths or pop-ups:
-
Create a layout that works
Markets usually run for long hours, from early morning till late evening. Most vendors get to their booths at different times. By the time I got there, I saw that some booths were already set up and tending to customers. Some walked by my booth while I was still unloading my inventory, but since I already had everything ready to go and just had to lay it in place, I was able to answer questions and give away some flyers.
Being extra prepared is the key to succeeding in a market as a small-business owner!
-
Map out the customer’s journey
While making a sale is important in a market, I also take this opportunity to assess how new customers feel about my branding. Sometimes, I see younger people more invested in my nails while older customers such as moms or professionals end up asking me logistical questions about the durability of press-on nails. Figuring out the right way to sell can be tricky, since the process is different each time.
Markets continually teach me how to gauge a customer’s interest. Over time, I have learned how to persuade people without seeming pushy. Each market, I try to do something that sets me apart or calls out to interested customers. This market, the bouquet of roses helped me draw the attention of moms or of families who were looking for a mother’s day gift.
10:00 AM: Cross things off the checklist
Once I have everything ready, I take place behind my booth and start greeting people. While I do this, I also like to cross things off my checklist to make sure I have everything I need ready to go. This step is crucial because if I forgot to lay out extra flyers or some samples, I can quickly get them out rather than fishing through my bag while a customer is waiting!
Finally: Shake off the nerves
Being a business owner usually means a lot of behind-the-scenes work. However, these markets put us founders in the centre stage by making us directly interact with customers and sell them on our products. I have found that the only way I can sell press-on nails to people is if I am sold on them myself, which I very much am.
Press-on nails have been an important part of my journey with business, art, and personal growth. And that is why I love speaking to their benefits. If you too are passionate about what you’re creating, a vendor market will be easy to coast if you follow these helpful tips!
Hey there! If you liked this blog, you might find more that interest you in LUNA LAB Blog. I write about press-on nails, founder life, small-business successes+failures, art & fashion, and more!

URL: https://www.lunalab.ca/blogs/all-about-press-on-nails/press-on-nails-an-unsustainable-trend-or-a-better-alternative

Press-on nails: An unsustainable trend or a better alternative?
Press-on nails (or artificial nails as they used to be called) have been dominating the beauty and wellness space since the last two decades. They are available everywhere in all price ranges, design, and form. I strongly believe that there is the right size, shape and style out there for everyone. But as much as these nails feel like all the rage, they are also thought to be a temporary trend. As a replacement for salon nails, press-on nails are considered not as high quality or convenient. If you’ve never tried them out, you might be wondering the same thing: are press-on nails just a trend that will fizzle out? Or are they actually a productive alternative to salon nails? Let’s find out!
As a nail artist who has been practicing nail art, design and manufacturing for 10+ years, I find that there are 3 reasons to declare press-on nails to be more everlasting than salon nails. Each reason is measured based on a benefit or quality you think is necessary in salon nails, and then we will assess how press-on nails perform in comparison.
-
Functionality and Convenience: You can come to your own rescue
Picture this: You are on your way to an event. While in the car, your gel nail gets stuck on your dress and breaks. It can happen to anyone, anytime. What might ensue now is a slight panic. Your manicured nails are meant to give you confidence; a chipped nail can sometimes come in the way! In such a situation, press-on nails come super handy. Having an extra nail or set allows you to quickly fix the broken nail and apply a new one.
If you’re your own nail technician, it’s much easier to take care of a nail emergency! (graphic)
When it comes to application wear, press-on nails do not last as long as salon nails. If applied carefully, press-ons can last you a maximum of two weeks. However, what you trade for longevity, you get back in time and convenience! Putting on your own nails takes less than 30 minutes and can be done at any time, even in the car on the way to an event!
-
Cost Benefits: Sustainable in the long run
If you’re someone who frequents salons for scheduled nail appointments a lot, you likely know that press-on nails cost much less than salon nails. When paying for salon nails, you pay not just for nails themselves, but also the service. In the case of press-ons, you purely pay for the best product possible and the rest is in your hands! If you’re nervous about application and removal, here is a breakdown of how I do it.
What makes press-on nails so affordable is the fact that they are reusable. By using nail tabs (which you can select as an option when placing your order), you can make your sets reusable for up to X times.
-
Quality-control: The perfect look each time
What makes press-on nails truly unique is you! Since you’re the one who will put them on, much of the control in this process lies in your hands. Title: 
      Nail Color Theory ft. LUNA LAB sets
    

URL: https://www.lunalab.ca/blogs/all-about-press-on-nails/nail-color-theory-ft-luna-lab-sets

Nail Color Theory ft. LUNA LAB sets
When it comes to nails, there are an endless number of unique combinations that can look appealing to the eye. However, not each combination might be your own personal favorite. A good rule of thumb when you order a custom design is to know what colors you’re going for. Usually, I notice that while this is a part of the process that excites a lot of people - choosing their design - it can end up ruining the results if you’re not mindful about the colors. They kind of make or break the whole look and a color that you just aren’t feeling this season, might end up feeling a bit out of place. However, a press-on nail color combination that you like and looks exactly the way you pictured can enhance your style game and confidence!
Nail Color Theory
I firmly believe that playing around with colors is super important, and fun! Each color looks different on everyone. Nail color theory can be a helpful way of discerning which colors suit you the best. Here are some helpful tips for when considering nail color theory for your press-on nails:
-
Colors in the same balance are easier to balance! I love a good color pop too, but keep in mind it doesn’t always work if there is no color cohesion in the palette.
-
A nail color can be matched with your undertone by tweaking the base color.
-
Some colors come out more depending on the season. For example, soft pastels like lilac, baby blue, and mint green tend to shine in the spring, evoking feelings of freshness and renewal, while deep tones like burgundy, emerald, and navy take center stage in the fall and winter, adding warmth and richness that match the cozy mood of the colder months.
-
If you have a signature color, we can find a way to include that color in any design you have in mind! As long as we’re mindful of how we optimize the palette, most colors can work together.
Understanding Color Palettes
Let's dive into some examples to see how different color choices create unique looks, and how understanding basic color theory can help you pick your perfect shade.
Caption: Short Coffin, Short Square
Deep and rich colors go really well with muted yet vibrant shades. This deep teal with brick red and soft pink creates a sharp contrast. Diverse color palettes in these shades look particularly good, especially with a pattern and a rich accent nail.
Caption: Medium Almond
With multi-pattern sets, I love using colors in a similar shade range. This orange and pink hue doesn’t overpower the pattern, and gives your nails a flattering soft aesthetic look. For people who like nude press-on nails, playing around with soft pastels is a great way of changing it up and still maintaining a clean and cohesive look.
Caption: Short Square, Extra Short Square
Contrary to popular belief, nude and neutral nails exist on a whole spectrum, from warm beige to light blush and pale yellow to deeper earthy browns. Finding the right shade of nude can be tricky. I have found that understanding your undertone is the best way to do it. If you have cool undertones, nudes with more pink or beige hues might be more flattering. For warmer undertones, nudes with more peach or golden brown shades can complement your complexion.
Caption: Short Oval, Short Almond.
Complementary colors are opposite each other on the color wheel and help to make the designs pop, such as a deep red against a warm beige. I also like to work with a lighter backdrop when creating themed nails, such as for the holiday season pictured here.
Caption: Medium Almond
I love mixing a classic design with a unique element. A timeless french tip can be elevated with bows, geometric shapes, even cow print. Achromatic colors like black and white look both dramatic and crisp. If you think this look won;t suit your undertone, you can adjust that by changing the shade of the nude backdrop against the black and white tips. This look is versatile both because of and in spite of its intricate detail!
These are the ways in which I leverage nail color theory to create fun and flattering nail set designs. I love to discuss your ideas. If you think you have a nail art idea you’re wondering will look good or not, reach out to me on instagram even if you don’t plan to order a set!

A week in my life: Nailfies edition
As a press-on nails business owner, what I do is not just for monetary gain but also (and more importantly) for my passion for nails! The art, design, quality - everything about press-on nails excites me but sometimes I have to remind myself to keep the spark alive.
This summer week, I decided to change my LUNA LAB press-on nail set everyday to match my mood and outfit. I had so much fun, here are all my looks + some nail set recommendations for you if you like what you see!
For Mango Monday, I kept it vibrant and playful.
I wanted to start the week off with my freshest nail set: this pastel set with blue, yellow and red hues was the perfect choice. My nails were the perfect bright contrast against a gloomy day and my biker jacket.
If you like this, you would like Sunset Bloom.
For Tangerine Tuesday, I kept it bright and sparkly.
The week started right with an important work event. I would be surrounded by people I admire, so I decided to channel the sparkle and pizzazz that so many LUNA LAB press-on nail sets have. I glammed up my outfit with this bright blue and orange nail set to match my color scheme.
If you like this, you would like Agate.
For Wind Down Wednesday, I kept it comfortable yet unique.
This was my first and only day fully spent at home this week. I decided to opt for a simple short nail set that would be easy to manage as I did my errands and went for a run. The Short size press-on nails are perfect for everyday tasks, while still looking cute and playful.
Not sure about your size? Check out the LUNA LAB nail sizing kit guide.
If you like this, you would like Besties Under the Sea or Colour Changing - Uranus.
For Teal & Tomato Thursday, I kept it colorful and summer-y.
The sun was pouring on us on Thursday, so I decided to channel summer vibes with my nails too. I opted for some contrast in both color and pattern, and chose to wear a bright color on which the print would stand out. My favorite moment of the day was when I found a ladybug in the grass and she crawled all over my palm!
If you like this, you would like Elemental Flow.
For Flourish Friday, I kept it simple yet elegant.
As I dressed up for a work conference, I decided to go for a muted, more corporate look for my nails. I opted for these black nails with tan details. They had the contrast details that still make the set interesting, and a color theme that aligned with a professional look.
If you like this, you would like Sculpture or Cappuccino.
For Pride Sunshine Sunday, I kept it festive, loud and proud!
Happy Pride! I am so excited to be participating in Pride festivities this weekend. The weather is beautiful and so are the celebrations happening in Toronto this year. To match the excitement and colors, I chose a bright pink and yellow nail set with smileys. I love doing intricate designs on my brightly colored nails to enhance their look, so this set was perfect for a fun Pride weekend!
If you like this, you would like Loud & Loved.

URL: https://www.lunalab.ca/products/sizing-kit

Sizing Kit
Not sure what size to order? Start with our Sizing Kit to find your perfect fit.
