Feel free to ask any questions via Instagram or email:
@lunalabnails
info@lunalab.ca
Customer Reviews
PRESS ON NAILS
How do I know the size I need?
We offer sizing kits to ensure the perfect fit. Please note that sizes may slightly vary depending on what shape you choose. Please make sure to buy individual sizing kits for each shape that you're interested in.
I know which set(s) I want but I don’t know my size.
No worries! Since you know which set(s) you want you can place an order and add the sizing kit(s). For example, you want to purchase “Picasso” but you want to try the shapes “Medium Ballerina” and “Ballerina” first.
You can place your order and select “Custom VIP” as the size. Then add the sizing kits in “Medium Ballerina” and “Ballerina” to your cart and checkout.
What we’ll do is ship you both sizing kits first. Once you measure your nails, learn your sizing, and send it back to us via DM or email, we’ll get started on your order and send it out to you!
Sizing Kit time frame?
Sizing kits are mailed as soon as possible through standard shipping 2-4 business days. Our processing time starts once you've sent us your sizes NOT when you first place your order.
How many nails come in each set?
All LUNA LAB nails come with at least 10 nails. Full sets come with 20 nails (two of each size).
VIP customers benefit from knowing their sizes with the option to get 10 uniquely sized nails, custom fit to their fingernails.
The "24 Nails" collection features luxe press on nails that come with 24-nails in each set!
What comes with my nails?
All orders come with application and removal instructions. Customers have the option to select their prep and adhesive preference.
1. None
2. Liquid glue and nail tabs
3. Full prep kit. A mini nail file, cuticle pusher, buffer, alcohol prep pads, liquid nail glue
What nail glue do you recommend?
We recommend a professional nail glue such as IBD 5 Second Nail Glue, KDS Nail Glue, or Nailene Super Glue
How long do the nails stay on?
Wear time depends on how well you prep your natural nails before application, how rough you are on your hands and your choice of adhesive. With nails tabs you can wear them for a few days or even a few hours if you're wearing them for a special occasion. With nail glue, for about 1 to 2 weeks.
I'm worried that my nails are going to pop off. Any tips on how I can avoid this?
Make sure to follow our Nail Prep instructions included with your order. This step is key to long wear. In addition, you can apply a Dehydrator and Primer for better adhesion. This is the same product nail techs use before gel or acrylic application so the product can adhere to your nails.
You can also try using both adhesive tabs and nail glue together. Follow nail prep instructions and apply the nail tabs. Then apply nail glue over the tabs or on the back of the nail. Press and hold the nails in place for a few seconds. This dual adhesive combo allows longer wear time.
Are the nails reusable?
Yes. The use of nail tabs will make the nails reusable.
For those that prefer nail glue, we suggest purchasing an inexpensive electric nail file. It'll gently buff away any built up glue on the back of the nails and give you many more wears.
Can you replace a lost nail?
Yes. Email us at info@lunalab.ca
Are the nails strong?
Yes, our nails are made with at least 3 coats of gel polish.
Do you offer custom designs?
We do! If you have a concept in mind or would like us to recreate something you saw on the gram, pinterest... anywhere just fill out our contact form so we can chat ideas.
*We do not recreate work from other press on nail sellers. If you love it, buy it from the original artist.
**Also, please note that not every idea or design fits our design style. So we may decline if its not something we can see doing. For recreations, we may ask if it’s ok to put a twist on the design to make it more our own.
Can I make changes to a design?
Yes, all sets are made to order and may be customized to your liking. If you prefer a different color, matte or glossy finish, shorter length or small design changes simply make a note in the special requests. For bigger changes that include adding on more or changing crystals please contact us first to approve changes.
GENERAL
How long will it take to ship my order?
*Please note that this turnaround is for creation time/ when we ship your order. Not how long it'll take for delivery. How fast you receive your order once we have shipped it out depends on the shipping fee you pay at checkout. Canada-Wide Free Shipping is Standard: 5-9 Business Days. Xpresspost 1-3 Business Days. Priority Express: 1-3 Business Days.
Press On Nails: Our current turn around is about 1-7 days. THIS IS JUST AN ESTIMATE. We do not guarantee that your order will be shipped within this time frame. They may be shipped sooner but can certainly take longer.
All sets are made to order and worked on, in the order they were received.
All of our nails are handcrafted solely by Louna Delicieux.
Sizing Sample Packs: 2-5 Business Days.
We truly appreciate your business and thank you for your patience as we make our way to your order.
Do you ship internationally?
Yes. We ship worldwide.
My package was sent back to you, can you resend it?
Yes of course. Simply contact us to make sure we have received it then pay the Re-Shipping Fee so we can send it back out.
Do you accept cancellations, returns or exchanges?
We gladly accept cancellations within 24 hours of purchase.
But due to the nature of our product; all sales are final (except in the case of products delivered in defective or damaged state. If so, email info@lunalab.ca and include an image of the defective or damaged product).
**Please read all information listed under the item description before ordering.
Also, double check shipping information before checking out. We are not held responsible for packages lost in transit, delivered packages that are missing or with incorrect address.
If there’s an apartment number make sure you enter it to avoid a Return To Sender issue.
If you move during your wait to receive your order, please update us with the new address. We are not held responsible for packages delivered to the wrong address. **

      The game changing approach to sizing your nails – LUNA LAB
    

URL: https://www.lunalab.ca/blogs/all-about-press-on-nails/the-game-changing-approach-to-sizing-your-nails

The game changing approach to sizing your nails
If you think that it’s tricky to get your nail size right, you’re not alone. In fact, the complexities of figuring out the right shape and size is what deters most people from ordering press-on nail sets. I can say this with confidence because it is the number one question I get on my Instagram, TikTok, and website queries. But once you know your size, you’re set for life and can finally start ordering the press-on nail designs you like!
The process of finding your right nail shape and size requires knowing some simple things. Some of these you might already have heard but struggled to believe, others are lesser known industry tips that nail techs know but don’t tell. Here at LUNA LAB, I want to set your press-on nails journey up for success, and so here is my guaranteed game changing approach to sizing your nails:
Use this nail size kit for reference:
Find the number that fits your index finger
Did you know that your index and ring finger are often the same size? (Note: This usually applies to women.)
If yours are roughly the same length, measure your index finger nail size first and apply the same to your ring finger.
Go one size up for your middle finger
It’s usually safe to assume that your middle finger will be one size larger than your index or ring finger, given that it is slightly longer and typically a bit wider at the base.
Thumb and pinky are usually unique
The thumb and pinky finger sizes are almost always unique to themselves and tend to be the easiest to measure accurately.
When in doubt, size up
You can always file and buff your nails to shape them how you want, but you can’t add more material to an already small nail. Sizing up helps eliminate risk, ensuring that your press-on nails can be adjusted to your right size if needed.
But hold up!
And anyone who suggests otherwise would be wrong! There are always unique cases and exceptions, so these rules may not apply to you. But you’re still in luck because the LUNA LAB sizing kit allows you to try on all our sizes for yourself and see which one fits on each nail bed. With 10 different sizes along with 11 shapes to choose from, your right size is just one order away.
Use code FREESIZING to get your first sizing kit free! Just pay for shipping.
What to do once you know your size
Now that you know your size, just send us a DM or email with your final size and we’ll start getting your order ready (if you’ve already placed it). Or if you’re not ready to place your order yet, you can just revel in the knowledge that you have just finished the most complicated part of this process: figuring out your nail size!
Hey there! If you liked reading this, you might find more stories that interest you in the LUNA LAB Blog. I write about press-on nails, founder life, small-business successes+failures, art & fashion, and more!

pages.title: Sunset Bloom – Long Square – LUNA LAB
pages.text:
Title: 
      Sunset Bloom – Long Square – LUNA LAB
    

URL: https://www.lunalab.ca/collections/signature/products/sunset-bloom

Sunset Bloom – Long Square
Catch golden hour on your fingertips with Sunset Bloom
A radiant blend of warm yellow, electric pink, and soft orange, kissed with floral detail. This set captures the magic of a summer sky melting into night, with delicate hand-painted blossoms and a bold marbled fade that dances in the light. It’s vibrant, artistic, and full of feel-good energy—a perfect choice when your nails are the outfit.
See something you love? You can order it as-is, or request a recreation in your favourite shape, size, or colour combo. Just leave a note at checkout or message us to customize it your way. Your dream set might already be here, waiting for a second debut ✨
PRESS ON NAILS
How do I know the size I need?
We offer sizing kits to ensure the perfect fit. Please note that sizes may slightly vary depending on what shape you choose. Please make sure to buy individual sizing kits for each shape that you're interested in.
I know which set(s) I want but I don’t know my size.
No worries! Since you know which set(s) you want you can place an order and add the sizing kit(s). For example, you want to purchase “Picasso” but you want to try the shapes “Medium Ballerina” and “Ballerina” first.
You can place your order and select “Custom VIP” as the size. Then add the sizing kits in “Medium Ballerina” and “Ballerina” to your cart and checkout.
What we’ll do is ship you both sizing kits first. Once you measure your nails, learn your sizing, and send it back to us via DM or email, we’ll get started on your order and send it out to you!
Sizing Kit time frame?
Sizing kits are mailed as soon as possible through standard shipping 2-4 business days. Our processing time starts once you've sent us your sizes NOT when you first place your order.
How many nails come in each set?
All LUNA LAB nails come with at least 10 nails. Full sets come with 20 nails (two of each size).
VIP customers benefit from knowing their sizes with the option to get 10 uniquely sized nails, custom fit to their fingernails.
The "24 Nails" collection features luxe press on nails that come with 24-nails in each set!
What comes with my nails?
All orders come with application and removal instructions. Customers have the option to select their prep and adhesive preference.
1. None
2. Liquid glue and nail tabs
3. Full prep kit. A mini nail file, cuticle pusher, buffer, alcohol prep pads, liquid nail glue
What nail glue do you recommend?
We recommend a professional nail glue such as IBD 5 Second Nail Glue, KDS Nail Glue, or Nailene Super Glue
How long do the nails stay on?
Wear time depends on how well you prep your natural nails before application, how rough you are on your hands and your choice of adhesive. With nails tabs you can wear them for a few days or even a few hours if you're wearing them for a special occasion. With nail glue, for about 1 to 2 weeks.
I'm worried that my nails are going to pop off. Any tips on how I can avoid this?
Make sure to follow our Nail Prep instructions included with your order. This step is key to long wear. In addition, you can apply a Dehydrator and Primer for better adhesion. This is the same product nail techs use before gel or acrylic application so the product can adhere to your nails.
You can also try using both adhesive tabs and nail glue together. Follow nail prep instructions and apply the nail tabs. Then apply nail glue over the tabs or on the back of the nail. Press and hold the nails in place for a few seconds. This dual adhesive combo allows longer wear time.
Are the nails reusable?
Yes. The use of nail tabs will make the nails reusable.
For those that prefer nail glue, we suggest purchasing an inexpensive electric nail file. It'll gently buff away any built up glue on the back of the nails and give you many more wears.
Can you replace a lost nail?
Yes. Email us at info@lunalab.ca
Are the nails strong?
Yes, our nails are made with at least 3 coats of gel polish.
Do you offer custom designs?
We do! If you have a concept in mind or would like us to recreate something you saw on the gram, pinterest... anywhere just fill out our contact form so we can chat ideas.
*We do not recreate work from other press on nail sellers. If you love it, buy it from the original artist.
**Also, please note that not every idea or design fits our design style. So we may decline if its not something we can see doing. For recreations, we may ask if it’s ok to put a twist on the design to make it more our own.
Can I make changes to a design?
Yes, all sets are made to order and may be customized to your liking. If you prefer a different color, matte or glossy finish, shorter length or small design changes simply make a note in the special requests. For bigger changes that include adding on more or changing crystals please contact us first to approve changes.
GENERAL
How long will it take to ship my order?
*Please note that this turnaround is for creation time/ when we ship your order. Not how long it'll take for delivery. How fast you receive your order once we have shipped it out depends on the shipping fee you pay at checkout. Canada-Wide Free Shipping is Standard: 5-9 Business Days. Xpresspost 1-3 Business Days. Priority Express: 1-3 Business Days.
Press On Nails: Our current turn around is about 1-7 days. THIS IS JUST AN ESTIMATE. We do not guarantee that your order will be shipped within this time frame. They may be shipped sooner but can certainly take longer.
All sets are made to order and worked on, in the order they were received.
All of our nails are handcrafted solely by Louna Delicieux.
Sizing Sample Packs: 2-5 Business Days.
We truly appreciate your business and thank you for your patience as we make our way to your order.
Do you ship internationally?
Yes. We ship worldwide.
My package was sent back to you, can you resend it?
Yes of course. Simply contact us to make sure we have received it then pay the Re-Shipping Fee so we can send it back out.
Do you accept cancellations, returns or exchanges?
We gladly accept cancellations within 24 hours of purchase.
But due to the nature of our product; all sales are final (except in the case of products delivered in defective or damaged state. If so, email info@lunalab.ca and include an image of the defective or damaged product).
**Please read all information listed under the item description before ordering.
Also, double check shipping information before checking out. We are not held responsible for packages lost in transit, delivered packages that are missing or with incorrect address.
If there’s an apartment number make sure you enter it to avoid a Return To Sender issue.
If you move during your wait to receive your order, please update us with the new address. We are not held responsible for packages delivered to the wrong address. **

Step into the haze of Lilac Mirage—a dreamy marble set where soft violets, creamy nudes, and gilded gold foil swirl together like magic on your fingertips. I know which set(s) I want but I don’t know my size.

I know which set(s) I want but I don’t know my size.
No worries! Since you know which set(s) you want you can place an order and add the sizing kit(s). For example, you want to purchase “Picasso” but you want to try the shapes “Medium Ballerina” and “Ballerina” first.
You can place your order and select “Custom VIP” as the size. Then add the sizing kits in “Medium Ballerina” and “Ballerina” to your cart and checkout.

How many nails come in each set?

1. None

What nail glue do you recommend?
We recommend a professional nail glue such as IBD 5 Second Nail Glue, KDS Nail Glue, or Nailene Super Glue
How long do the nails stay on?
Wear time depends on how well you prep your natural nails before application, how rough you are on your hands and your choice of adhesive. With nails tabs you can wear them for a few days or even a few hours if you're wearing them for a special occasion. With nail glue, for about 1 to 2 weeks.

Are the nails reusable?
Yes. The use of nail tabs will make the nails reusable.

Can you replace a lost nail?
Yes. Email us at info@lunalab.ca
Are the nails strong?
Yes, our nails are made with at least 3 coats of gel polish.

We do! If you have a concept in mind or would like us to recreate something you saw on the gram, pinterest... anywhere just fill out our contact form so we can chat ideas.
*We do not recreate work from other press on nail sellers. If you love it, buy it from the original artist.
**Also, please note that not every idea or design fits our design style. So we may decline if its not something we can see doing. For recreations, we may ask if it’s ok to put a twist on the design to make it more our own.
Can I make changes to a design?
Yes, all sets are made to order and may be customized to your liking. If you prefer a different color, matte or glossy finish, shorter length or small design changes simply make a note in the special requests. For bigger changes that include adding on more or changing crystals please contact us first to approve changes.
GENERAL
How long will it take to ship my order?
*Please note that this turnaround is for creation time/ when we ship your order. Not how long it'll take for delivery. Yes. We ship worldwide.
My package was sent back to you, can you resend it?
Yes of course. Simply contact us to make sure we have received it then pay the Re-Shipping Fee so we can send it back out.

We gladly accept cancellations within 24 hours of purchase.
But due to the nature of our product; all sales are final (except in the case of products delivered in defective or damaged state. If so, email info@lunalab.ca and include an image of the defective or damaged product).
**Please read all information listed under the item description before ordering.
Also, double check shipping information before checking out. We are not held responsible for packages lost in transit, delivered packages that are missing or with incorrect address.
If there’s an apartment number make sure you enter it to avoid a Return To Sender issue.
If you move during your wait to receive your order, please update us with the new address. We are not held responsible for packages delivered to the wrong address. **

How long do the nails stay on?

Title: 
      Cuticle Oil Pen – LUNA LAB
    

URL: https://www.lunalab.ca/collections/view-all/products/cuticle-oil-pen

Cuticle Oil Pen
Nourish and heal dry cuticles quickly with our revitalizing blend of vitamins and oils. Unlike nail treatments that are no more than moisturizer, LUNA LAB cuticle oil pens encourage nail growth and penetrate deeply to heal and protect worn-down cuticles and damaged nails.
Directions - Use daily to maintain soft and moisturized cuticles. After cuticle application gently massage into skin for a few minutes to both condition and stimulate blood flow.
Milk and Honey - Honey naturally soothes and moisturizes, while lactic acid from milk refreshes and stimulates the skin.
Ingredients: Sunflower Seed Oil, Milk Extract, Honey, Vitamin E, Fragrance
Mango - Pamper cuticles with a special blend of Jojoba and Meadowfoam Seeds oils that effectively condition dry or ragged areas around the nails; keeping them soft and moisturized.
Ingredients: Safflower, Jojoba Oil, Grape seed Oil, Mango, Vitamin E, Fragrance
Caution: For external use only. Avoid contact with eyes. If contact occurs, flush thorough with water. Discontinue use of irritation or rash appear.

How do I know the size I need?
We offer sizing kits to ensure the perfect fit. Please note that sizes may slightly vary depending on what shape you choose. Please make sure to buy individual sizing kits for each shape that you're interested in.
I know which set(s) I want but I don’t know my size.
No worries! Since you know which set(s) you want you can place an order and add the sizing kit(s). For example, you want to purchase “Picasso” but you want to try the shapes “Medium Ballerina” and “Ballerina” first.
You can place your order and select “Custom VIP” as the size. Then add the sizing kits in “Medium Ballerina” and “Ballerina” to your cart and checkout.
What we’ll do is ship you both sizing kits first. Once you measure your nails, learn your sizing, and send it back to us via DM or email, we’ll get started on your order and send it out to you!

Sizing kits are mailed as soon as possible through standard shipping 2-4 business days. Our processing time starts once you've sent us your sizes NOT when you first place your order.

All LUNA LAB nails come with at least 10 nails. Full sets come with 20 nails (two of each size).

We recommend a professional nail glue such as IBD 5 Second Nail Glue, KDS Nail Glue, or Nailene Super Glue
How long do the nails stay on?
Wear time depends on how well you prep your natural nails before application, how rough you are on your hands and your choice of adhesive. With nails tabs you can wear them for a few days or even a few hours if you're wearing them for a special occasion. With nail glue, for about 1 to 2 weeks.
I'm worried that my nails are going to pop off. Any tips on how I can avoid this?
Make sure to follow our Nail Prep instructions included with your order. This step is key to long wear. In addition, you can apply a Dehydrator and Primer for better adhesion. This is the same product nail techs use before gel or acrylic application so the product can adhere to your nails.
You can also try using both adhesive tabs and nail glue together. Follow nail prep instructions and apply the nail tabs. Then apply nail glue over the tabs or on the back of the nail. Press and hold the nails in place for a few seconds. This dual adhesive combo allows longer wear time.
Are the nails reusable?
Yes. The use of nail tabs will make the nails reusable.
For those that prefer nail glue, we suggest purchasing an inexpensive electric nail file. It'll gently buff away any built up glue on the back of the nails and give you many more wears.
